en: Heals all allies within a certain nearby area for HP equal to <@ba.vup>110%</> of Saria's ATK

The next attack restores HP equal to <@ba.vup>150%</> of ATK to one nearby allied unit below half HP
<@ba.rem>Can hold 2 charges</>

All nearby allies restore HP equal to <@ba.vup>20%</> of Saria's ATK per second
All nearby enemies take <@ba.vup>+40%</> Arts damage and have Movement Speed <@ba.vup>-60%</>

The next attack has an <@ba.vup>expanded</> splash radius and deals Arts damage equal to <@ba.vup>180%</> of ATK
<@ba.rem>Can hold 2 charges</>
When Dusk or a "Freeling" defeats an enemy, Dusk gains 2% ATK, stacking up to 15 times
The first time attacking an enemy after deployment, summons a "Freeling" at the target's location (deployable ground tile) for 25 seconds
Attack Range <@ba.vup>expanded</>, ATK <@ba.vup>+29%</>, ASPD <@ba.vup>+29</>, attacks all enemies within Attack Range, and Arts damage dealt to enemies below half HP increases to <@ba.vup>120%</>

Attack Interval <@ba.vdown>increased</>, prioritizes unblocked enemies, Attack Range and splash radius <@ba.vup>expanded</>, ATK <@ba.vup>+70%</>; each attack summons/refreshes a <@ba.vup>"Freeling"</> at the target's location (deployable ground tile) for 25 seconds

The next attack has an <@ba.vup>expanded</> splash radius and deals Arts damage equal to <@ba.vup>210%</> of ATK
<@ba.rem>Can hold 2 charges</>
Attack Range <@ba.vup>expanded</>, ATK <@ba.vup>+40%</>, ASPD <@ba.vup>+40</>, attacks all enemies within Attack Range, and Arts damage dealt to enemies below half HP increases to <@ba.vup>125%</>

Attack Interval <@ba.vdown>increased</>, prioritizes unblocked enemies, Attack Range and splash radius <@ba.vup>expanded</>, ATK <@ba.vup>+100%</>; each attack summons/refreshes a <@ba.vup>"Freeling"</> at the target's location (deployable ground tile) for 25 seconds
In <@ba.kw>Integrated Strategies</>, attacks one additional target
